format: {name, note, text | hex, parses, body, problem?, pond?}. `text` is the exact UTF-8 text; `hex` the raw bytes when they are not UTF-8. `parses`: a strict JSON parser accepts it (a key named twice in one object, after escapes, and a lone surrogate escape are refused). `body`: it is a revision body: it parses strictly, is a top-level object and is a valid instructable. `problem` (when body is false): duplicateKey when the text is otherwise JSON but names a key twice, else invalid. `pond`, only where present, is the Pond's own answer where it differs from docs/mailbox-protocol.md.

cases.name: strict-valid-body
cases.text: {"v":1,"title":"Rotate the staging deploy key","why":"The key is 90 days old.","steps":[{"do":"Open the deploy settings","id":"s1"}]}

cases.name: strict-valid-pair
cases.note: a surrogate pair escape is one character
cases.text: {"v":1,"title":"Rotate the staging deploy key","why":"Done \ud83d\ude00","steps":[{"do":"Open the deploy settings","id":"s1"}]}

cases.name: strict-lone-high-surrogate
cases.text: {"v":1,"title":"Rotate the staging deploy key","why":"Done \ud83d","steps":[{"do":"Open the deploy settings","id":"s1"}]}

cases.name: strict-lone-low-surrogate
cases.text: {"v":1,"title":"Rotate the staging deploy key","why":"Done \ude00","steps":[{"do":"Open the deploy settings","id":"s1"}]}

cases.name: strict-reversed-pair
cases.note: low then high: two lone surrogates
cases.text: {"v":1,"title":"Rotate the staging deploy key","why":"Done \ude00\ud83d","steps":[{"do":"Open the deploy settings","id":"s1"}]}

cases.name: strict-lone-surrogate-key
cases.note: a lone surrogate in a key

cases.name: strict-duplicate-top-level
cases.note: title named twice at the top
cases.text: {"v":1,"title":"Rotate the staging deploy key","title":"Rotate the production deploy key","steps":[{"do":"Open the deploy settings","id":"s1"}]}

cases.name: strict-duplicate-nested
cases.note: a key named twice in a nested object
cases.text: {"v":1,"title":"Rotate the staging deploy key","steps":[{"do":"Open the deploy settings","id":"s1"}],"verify":{"do":"The deploy passes","do":"The deploy fails"}}

cases.name: strict-duplicate-in-array
cases.note: a key named twice in an object inside an array
cases.text: {"v":1,"title":"Rotate the staging deploy key","steps":[{"do":"Open the deploy settings","id":"s1","code":"deploy-key show","code":"deploy-key delete"}]}

cases.name: strict-duplicate-escaped-title
cases.note: title spelled once with an escape
cases.text: {"v":1,"title":"Rotate the staging deploy key","\u0074itle":"Rotate the production deploy key","steps":[{"do":"Open the deploy settings","id":"s1"}]}

cases.name: strict-same-key-different-objects
cases.note: one key in two objects is no duplicate
cases.text: {"v":1,"title":"Rotate the staging deploy key","steps":[{"do":"Open the deploy settings","id":"s1"},{"do":"Rotate the key","id":"s2"}]}

cases.name: strict-trailing-text
cases.text: {"v":1,"title":"Rotate the staging deploy key","why":"The key is 90 days old.","steps":[{"do":"Open the deploy settings","id":"s1"}]} x

cases.name: strict-trailing-space
cases.note: white space after the value is fine
cases.text: {"v":1,"title":"Rotate the staging deploy key","why":"The key is 90 days old.","steps":[{"do":"Open the deploy settings","id":"s1"}]}

cases.name: strict-not-utf8
cases.note: raw bytes that are not UTF-8: {"a":"<FF>"}
